title: OrchestrationHeader
description: Static configuration for the NenFlow v3 orchestration status panel, written by the orchestrator at run start.

maxSubagents.description: Maximum number of subagents that can run concurrently (1 for sequential NenFlow v3)

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed phases (Route D continuation limit)

concurrency.description: Number of subagents that can run in parallel (1 for NenFlow v3 sequential mode)

roles.description: Per-LLM model assignments for each role in the orchestration

role.description: The orchestration role (e.g. researcher, planner, executor, verifier)

model.description: The model ID assigned to this role (e.g. deepseek-v4-pro)

provider.description: The provider assigned to this role (e.g. deepseek)
